cache_key_collision.consequence: Different physical image and pose resolve to the same persistent cache entry.

fft_collision.consequence: Distinct equal-sum windows reuse stale FFTs and return incorrect score maps.

relative_unavailable_queries.consequence: A feature for an early decision depends on fine matches of an unexecuted query.

unsafe_zero_wrong_fallback.consequence: The zero-wrong selector returns an unsafe finite threshold when no threshold meets its condition.

early_exit_bypasses_main_cut.consequence: API permits early acceptance below the main calibrated cut; T11 final caller guards this with max().

augmented_context_reintroduces_unavailab.consequence: Jetson scale-augmented training copies rebuild context with ranks >=5 despite m=5 base features.
